[h1]A Sci-fi fantasy lovers Dreams [/h1] 
TL;DR 
Warhammer 40k: Space Marine is a very violent, loud and satisfying Warhammer game. The guns are all super fun to use and sound like hand cannons. The story is the usual affair with Warhammer games where orcs are running amuck but the chaos space marines are the real enemy, its never been the most complex or very interesting story, the gameplay is the main factor which can be a little repetitive but very entertaining for the first while. The multiplayer is also quite fun with multiple game modes and fighting styles to use. It’s also a pretty accurate game to the Warhammer universe.


Follow us here 
Steamship Discord: https://discord.gg/XbsKrtK
Steamship Steam group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/thesteamship

Pros 
[list] 
[*]Fun & loud weapons
[*]Accurate to Warhammer universe
[*]Fun combat
[*]Jump packs [/list]

Cons 
[list]
[*]Mediocre story
[*]Repetitive gameplay eventually[/list]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1] Gameplay[/h1]
The Gameplay in Space Marine is the best part of the game for sure with loud and badass guns everything has explosive shots and make enemies just pop. Throughout the game, you will be given a variety of weapons to switch out and all of them are satisfying to play with either using a giant hammer your regular chainsword or a jump pack is super fun to play with. The problem is once your about half way through the game it get repetitive as you will tend to stick with certain weapons and you’ll be fighting hordes of the same enemy, it will start to feel more like a wave based shooter than an action game.

[h1] Story[/h1]
The story pretty predictable with an odd twist at the end that I wasn’t sure that I liked. The rest of the game it’s just the regular Warhammer jargon of orcs are bad let’s go stop there waaaagh and oh the chaos are here doing demon stuff let’s stop them now. It’s a basic Warhammer game story but it’s still nice to hear and fits nicely.

[h1] Characters[/h1] 
The characters are forgettable as they essentially all warriors conversations are like listening too two slabs of concrete talk, they do stick to their race stereotypes orcs sounds like lobotomized Scotsmen , chaos all sound like angry and overconfident warriors and space marines sound like slabs of concrete. 

[h1] Art/Graphics [/h1]
The game looks great and all the models look like what your imagine, bulky space marines cant jump or run really fast and the orcs are of varying sizes and easy to distinguish.  Everything in the game looks like actual Warhammer models. The sound design is great as well you are submersed in an actual waaagh and have to be cautious at all moments throughout the game.


[h1]Bonus Notes[/h1]

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine is a 3rd Person Hack n Slash kind of game
You play as Captian Titus of the Ultramarines. With 2 other Ultramarines at your side (In a way)

This game make you feel like a badass. Chopping,tearing,smashing,squashing and exploding your enemies. You can pull your enemies into your Chainsword or throw your mighty axe at an enemy Orcs head. You can kick an enemy into oblivion

I had a lot of fun playing this game. Fury mode makes everything feel more....Badass

UNITL!...the final hours of the game the enemy Renegades comes along and turns your Badass, Ultramarine, hack n slash player into a...Guardmas. You will die from these guys many many times. They will blow you up, squash you, kick you into oblivion and...shoot you til you decide that maybe fighting for the Emperor was a bad thing.

Yes the game makes you feel like a badass and who doesnt like being a badass? But you only notice that the only thing making you feel like a badass...is your sheild...

Boss Grimskull will do anything to kill you. If you have no sheild and only full health...well say goodbye because if he hits you even once...you will die. Why? because your sheild is gone...

I really really like this game. Executing enemies is fun as hell :D Its just the little annoying things that make a game die...
-The useless friendly Ai
-The one hit kill bosses

But all in all the game is great fun. If only the campaign was co-op :D

8.1/10 Makes you feel like a badass guardmen

Ok this game is really good. Like one of the best third person shooters ive ever played.
However a little game called transformers war for cybertron and fall of cybertron. Both of which are have better game mechanics and have more gameplay diversity. 

But this game is still good non the less. If you like the warhammer universe get this game. Otherwise id reccomend any of the high noon transformers games over this

This game has a single flaw that sadly killed it for me. No dedicated servers. Because of that the multiplayer died.

That said, the single player alone is worth it IMO.
Very entertaining gameplay and nice campaign. You will not be able to stop playing through the whole thing in one sitting.
